facts.text: Wayland was discovered and colonized during the Galactic Republic's second wave of expansion, and served as a field hospital during the Mandalorian Wars.

evidence.quote: Wayland was discovered and colonized during the Galactic Republic's second wave of expansion, and served as a field hospital during the Mandalorian Wars.

facts.text: It was also the site of a factory for Lhosan Industries.

evidence.quote: It was also the site of a factory for Lhosan Industries.

facts.text: At some point after the Third Galactic War, a filing error removed all record of the planet from astrogation charts and planetary logs, so that years later, people living during the reign of Palpatine were unsure if "Wayland" was the planet's real name or a Imperial codename.

evidence.quote: At some point after the Third Galactic War, a filing error removed all record of the planet from astrogation charts and planetary logs, so that years later, people living during the reign of Palpatine were unsure if "Wayland" was the planet's real name or a Imperial codename.

facts.text: The Human colonists quickly came into conflict with Wayland's indigenous sentient species, the "crystal-skinned" Myneyrshi and the "lumpy armor-plated" Psadans.

evidence.quote: The Human colonists quickly came into conflict with Wayland's indigenous sentient species, the "crystal-skinned" Myneyrshi and the "lumpy armor-plated" Psadans.

facts.text: In their early years, the colonists came to dominate the Myneryrshi and Psadans with Republic technology, but isolated over time, the colonists technologically regressed to the level of the indigenous species.

evidence.quote: In their early years, the colonists came to dominate the Myneryrshi and Psadans with Republic technology, but isolated over time, the colonists technologically regressed to the level of the indigenous species.

facts.text: Centuries later, Wayland was rediscovered by the mad genetic terrorist Zeta Magnus who constructed an underground laboratory facility there.

evidence.quote: Centuries later, Wayland was rediscovered by the mad genetic terrorist Zeta Magnus who constructed an underground laboratory facility there.

facts.text: When Magnus pledged fealty to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, he granted Darth Sidious access to his Wayland facility.

evidence.quote: When Magnus pledged fealty to the Confederacy of Independent Systems, he granted Darth Sidious access to his Wayland facility.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, the Wayland system was restricted by the Confederacy, and a battle claiming the life of a Jedi was fought over the planet at some point.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, the Wayland system was restricted by the Confederacy, and a battle claiming the life of a Jedi was fought over the planet at some point.

facts.text: Count Dooku would use Magnus' facility to experiment with dashta eel tissue samples for his JK-13 security droids and for experimenting with cloning an army of Morgukai warriors.

evidence.quote: Count Dooku would use Magnus' facility to experiment with dashta eel tissue samples for his JK-13 security droids and for experimenting with cloning an army of Morgukai warriors.

facts.text: Darth Sidious determined the facility's isolation and uncharted nature made it ideal for a storehouse of arcane artifacts and secret technology.

evidence.quote: Darth Sidious determined the facility's isolation and uncharted nature made it ideal for a storehouse of arcane artifacts and secret technology.

facts.text: The Galactic Empire had an occupation on the planet.

evidence.quote: The Galactic Empire had an occupation on the planet.

facts.text: They enslaved the native Myneyrshi, Psadans, and their allies.

evidence.quote: They enslaved the native Myneyrshi, Psadans, and their allies.

facts.text: Emperor Palpatine built his storehouse into Mount Tantiss in Wayland's northern hemisphere and placed a Dark Jedi as its Guardian.

evidence.quote: Emperor Palpatine built his storehouse into Mount Tantiss in Wayland's northern hemisphere and placed a Dark Jedi as its Guardian.

facts.text: In 3 BBY, the Empire built a research station.

evidence.quote: In 3 BBY, the Empire built a research station.

facts.text: The research station, under the command of Commandant, Col. Milosh Muhrlein, was suspected of selling experimental droids protocols and devices on the black market.

evidence.quote: The research station, under the command of Commandant, Col. Milosh Muhrlein, was suspected of selling experimental droids protocols and devices on the black market.

facts.text: This practice ended when Imperial Intelligence agent Jahan Cross and his droid IN-GA investigate and eliminated Muhrlein.

evidence.quote: This practice ended when Imperial Intelligence agent Jahan Cross and his droid IN-GA investigate and eliminated Muhrlein.

facts.text: The Imperial occupation of Wayland ended shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

evidence.quote: The Imperial occupation of Wayland ended shortly after the Battle of Endor in 4 ABY.

facts.text: In 9 ABY,The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook states that the Guardian created his kingdom five years after the Battle of Endor.

evidence.quote: In 9 ABY,The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook states that the Guardian created his kingdom five years after the Battle of Endor.

facts.text: That battle took place in 4 ABY per The New Essential Chronology after five years without Imperial contact in the wake of Palpatine's death, the Guardian established a city he populated with Wayland's three native populations: Humans, Myneyrshi, and the Psadan.

evidence.quote: That battle took place in 4 ABY per The New Essential Chronology after five years without Imperial contact in the wake of Palpatine's death, the Guardian established a city he populated with Wayland's three native populations: Humans, Myneyrshi, and the Psadan.

facts.text: The clone killed the Guardian and maintained the settlement himself.

evidence.quote: The clone killed the Guardian and maintained the settlement himself.

facts.text: The mad clone used his powers to bring a forced peace between the Humans, Psadans and Myneryrshi, culminating in a tense coexistence in a city southwest of Mount Tantiss.

evidence.quote: The mad clone used his powers to bring a forced peace between the Humans, Psadans and Myneryrshi, culminating in a tense coexistence in a city southwest of Mount Tantiss.

facts.text: Even later in 9 ABY, Grand Admiral Thrawn descended upon Wayland to claim the cloaking shield technology and thousands of Spaarti cloning cylinders that he used in his war against the New Republic.

evidence.quote: Even later in 9 ABY, Grand Admiral Thrawn descended upon Wayland to claim the cloaking shield technology and thousands of Spaarti cloning cylinders that he used in his war against the New Republic.

facts.text: After the destruction of Mount Tantiss, Wayland became a planet of particular interest to the New Republic as they took the planet away from the Galactic Empire.

evidence.quote: After the destruction of Mount Tantiss, Wayland became a planet of particular interest to the New Republic as they took the planet away from the Galactic Empire.

facts.text: Researchers and New Republic Intelligence officers scoured the planet and ruins for clues to aid in their defeat of Imperial warlords, discovering evidence that would lead to the political fallout of Bothan involvement in the destruction of Caamas.

evidence.quote: Researchers and New Republic Intelligence officers scoured the planet and ruins for clues to aid in their defeat of Imperial warlords, discovering evidence that would lead to the political fallout of Bothan involvement in the destruction of Caamas.

facts.text: The New Republic also relocated the Noghri to the colony of New Nystao on Wayland to escape their collapsing home world of Honoghr.

evidence.quote: The New Republic also relocated the Noghri to the colony of New Nystao on Wayland to escape their collapsing home world of Honoghr.

facts.text: In 24 ABY, the Book of Sith was rediscovered by Luke Skywalker amid the ruins of the Emperor's storehouses at Mount Tantiss, after stumbling upon a chamber that, until that year remained hidden.
entities: Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side

evidence.quote: In 24 ABY, the Book of Sith was rediscovered by Luke Skywalker amid the ruins of the Emperor's storehouses at Mount Tantiss, after stumbling upon a chamber that, until that year remained hidden.

facts.text: In 25 ABY, Wayland acted as the site of the first interrogation of the Yuuzhan Vong priestess Elan and her familiar Vergere, but due to an attack by Yuuzhan Vong forces they were relocated.

evidence.quote: In 25 ABY, Wayland acted as the site of the first interrogation of the Yuuzhan Vong priestess Elan and her familiar Vergere, but due to an attack by Yuuzhan Vong forces they were relocated.

facts.text: It also served as a safe world for New Republic personnel during the early stages of the Yuuzhan Vong War.
